title: Unitary method & best buy
examples: How do I find the price per unit if it is not given?
When should I use the best buy method?
Can I use this method for mixing ingredients too?

explain.say: Today we learn about finding the best buy. We will compare different prices for the same items. This helps us save money when shopping.
First, we need to find the price per unit. This means finding the cost for just one single item. You divide the total cost by the number of items.
For example, a packet of pencils costs six pounds. It contains thirty pencils. We divide six by thirty.
Next, we compare two or more offers. We calculate the price per unit for each one. The lowest price per unit is the best buy. This saves you the most money.

draw.text: Lowest Price per Unit is Best Buy

explain.say: Consider juice boxes. Option A costs four pounds for twelve boxes. Option B costs five pounds for twenty boxes. We must find the unit rate for both.

faq.q: What is the price per unit really?
faq.a: It is simply the cost of one single item. You find it by dividing the total cost by the total number of items.
asks: How do I find the unit rate?
What does unit rate mean for price?

faq.q: Do I always have to compare two options?
faq.a: No, you can compare three or more options. You just repeat the process for every single choice given.
asks: Can I compare more than two things?
How many items can I compare?

faq.q: What if the units are different, like kilograms and grams?
faq.a: You must make the units the same before dividing. Convert everything to the smallest common unit first.
asks: Do I need to convert units?
What if I have mixed measurements?

faq.q: Is the best buy always the cheapest option overall?
faq.a: Not always. You must check the price per unit. A slightly more expensive pack might offer a much lower unit rate.
asks: Is lowest total cost the same as best buy?
Does unit rate always mean saving money?

faq.q: Can I use this when buying ingredients for cooking?
faq.a: Yes, you can. You would find the price per gram or per millilitre for different brands.
asks: Can I use this for recipes?
Does this work for cooking supplies?

facts: Price per unit is found by dividing the total cost by the total quantity.
When comparing buys, the lowest price per unit is the better value.
Always ensure the units of measurement are the same before calculating the rate.
This method helps consumers make informed purchasing decisions.

quiz.say: A bag of apples costs eight pounds for five kilograms. Another bag costs ten pounds for ten kilograms. Which bag is the best buy?
quiz.why: Option B costs one pound per kilogram, which is less than Option A's cost of one point six pounds per kilogram.

wrong.1: This is tempting because the total cost of eight pounds seems lower than ten pounds.
wrong.2: This is tempting because the second option uses a round number for the weight.
wrong.3: This is tempting because the calculation seems too easy to compare.

quiz.say: A box of crayons costs twelve pounds for forty crayons. A set costs nine pounds for sixty crayons. Which set offers the best value?
quiz.why: The set costs one and a half pence per crayon, which is less than the box's cost of three pence per crayon.

wrong.1: This is tempting because the total cost of twelve pounds is less than nine pounds.
wrong.2: This is tempting because both numbers are divisible by common factors.
wrong.3: This is tempting because the numbers look complicated to calculate.

quiz.say: If you buy 2 litres of juice for seven pounds, what is the price per litre?
quiz.why: You divide the total cost of seven pounds by the two litres to find the cost for one litre.

wrong.0: This is tempting because you multiplied seven by two instead of dividing.
wrong.1: This is tempting because you might have divided by ten instead of two.
wrong.2: This is tempting because you rounded the answer down to a whole number.
